notes: Bug fixes from a full check of the client. Gifts: two changes to your save at the same moment no longer lose one; a gift no longer hangs if the game closes mid-answer; large unlocks no longer freeze the panel. Panel: no longer crashes if a font file or the launcher is missing; settings are saved safely; buttons no longer stay stuck after a failed request; the item list loads again after a failed first try. Overlay: no flicker of broken parts while the game rewrites its files; two quest objectives or parts with the same name keep their own progress; gear-set names (Champion, Nikola) are never used as behemoth names. Game mod 6.8: no game functions called off the game's thread; the damage multiplier no longer drops a behemoth to 1 HP after being switched off and on, and only runs on the hunt server; a behemoth whose health read 0 at spawn is shown again. Launcher 1.6.11: a version that only started slowly is no longer blocked for good; safer update lock. Close the game fully and start it again after updating.
